sources.title: G4.4 PositionOnly Input Corrective Amendment v0.1
GT-G4-4-CORR-01 Corrective Implementation Design and P31 Freeze Candidate v0.1

trusted_statements.auto_intent: second compatible contact while first is Pending forms viewport gesture; once Ink-locked, later compatible contacts become independent Ink sessions
trusted_statements.multi_ink: eligible contacts become independent Ink sessions; automatic two-finger viewport gesture disabled
trusted_statements.gesture_priority: second compatible contact while first is Pending forms viewport gesture; if first is already Ink-locked, later contact is ignored and first continues drawing

dependency.downstream_preservation_rule: Preserve existing G4.5 brush implementation; forward-integrate corrective main later and rerun interaction-coupled evidence only.
